description: Explicit `/name` invocation of a user-authored subagent (docs/plans/custom-subagents.md P2). Requires a definition seeded at ~/.claude/agents/copse-eval-reviewer.md — see the plan's validation section. Proves the agent the user named is the one that runs: the turn pre-invokes it deterministically, so this fails if pre-invocation stops firing, fires the wrong definition, or the agent dies.
prompts: /copse-eval-reviewer review src/greet.ts and tell me what is wrong with it
